name: EPCIS 2.0.1 source exchange (epcis-json@1) and explicit VSC mapping (epcis-vsc@1)
notes: Pinned EPCIS 2.0.1 JSON Schema 0f46ff694efffd8d8ce840a33dfde84228add11b516b8b258f3200740ae210af and context 5056c65f991425b1d3a35e35edf4f7d0c7ff56cf688c2912b930f93494713737. Every identifier uses the GS1 demonstration prefix 952 and example.org hosts.

vectors.description: A neutral EPCISDocument carrying a two-stage TransformationEvent chain, a commissioning ObjectEvent, an AssociationEvent (component membership), an AggregationEvent (shipping container), a separately constructed TransactionEvent with parties, and a sensor observation without an eventID. Parsed under the default limits, validated against the pinned 2.0.1 schema, every event digested and identified.
One page of a standard query result: the same events under the EPCISQueryDocument envelope, located at the query result pointer.

The canonical event-body digest ignores formatting and member order, excludes recordTime and errorDeclaration, and includes the sorted context digests; a changed recordTime or error declaration is a new observation, a changed body is a conflict.
An event without an eventID is valid EPCIS; its local ingestion identity is derived from the source digest and the event pointer, labelled local and never inserted into the source.

An error declaration is retained with its corrective event references; when the corrective event is held the declaration is resolved, when it is absent it stays unresolved. Neither is a VSC correction or an authority grant.

A document the pinned schema rejects (no action on an ObjectEvent, a malformed zone offset) is safe to parse and is retained with failed findings; it is never publishable on that basis and never repaired.
A member name repeated within one object is refused before parsing, whatever the values.
A byte sequence that is not well-formed UTF-8 is refused before parsing.
A container nested past the depth limit (64) is refused.
A number literal a double cannot carry (here one that overflows to infinity) is refused.
A number literal whose decimal digits a double cannot carry exactly is refused rather than silently rounded.
A document over the byte limit is refused; the limit here is lowered to 64 bytes so the vector stays small.
More events than the per-document limit (lowered to 2 here) is refused; a larger source is split, never truncated.
An XML media type is refused by name; this profile reads JSON and JSON-LD only.

Every event of the five-event document mapped into the VSC profile with an explicit outcome: the commissioning ObjectEvent is lossless and yields a structurally valid unsigned SEAL carrying the source reference; events with parties, transactions, sensors, quantities or a caller-decided transformation action are transformed with their losses named; an in_progress disposition the custody model does not name is unsupported. No SEAL is issued, and nothing touches a token.

vectors.description: Valid EPCIS that lacks a disposition is insufficient-data and stays evidence only; an event naming an owning party and a business location maps with the configured issuer as actor, never with the party or location the event names.
